entities.name: UE requesting SMS only
entities.description: A UE that requested SMS only in the combined attach procedure or combined tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION message
entities.description: A message that may be ignored by a UE that requested SMS only.

entities.name: Paging indication with CN domain indicator set to CS
entities.description: A paging indication that may be ignored by a UE that requested SMS only.

entities.name: Ignore CS domain messages
entities.description: The UE may ignore CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION messages or paging indications with CN domain indicator set to CS when it requested SMS only.

relations.description: The condition of UE requesting SMS only establishes the behavior of ignoring CS domain messages.
The ignore behavior applies to CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION messages.
The ignore behavior applies to paging indications with CN domain indicator set to CS.
